inAppFreeROMs.description: Allows downloading free ROMs directly in the app. Disabled for App Store builds.

romPathMigrator.description: Enables the ROM path migration tool.

cheatsUseSwiftUI.description: Use SwiftUI for the cheats interface.

retroarchBuiltinEditor.description: Enables the built-in RetroArch editor. Disabled for App Store builds.

advancedSkinFeatures.description: Enables advanced skin features like filters and debug mode.

contentlessCores.description: Enables contentless cores like DOOM, Quake, etc.

cheatsOnlineLookup.description: Enables online lookup for cheat codes via GitHub API with 24h disk cache.

dynamicLibretroScanner.description: Scans Frameworks/ at startup for bare .libretro.framework dylibs and registers them as thin-wrapper cores (no RetroArch binary required). Off by default — enable in Settings > Advanced > Feature Flags to test.

pauseTileMenu.description: Experimental tile/grid based pause menu that floats over the game screen instead of the classic tab/list panel. Enable in Settings > Advanced > Feature Flags.

tapToRemapUI.description: Tap-to-remap UX in button remapping settings: press a physical controller button to select the remapping destination instead of choosing from a list. Disabled by default during development — enable in Settings > Advanced > Feature Flags.

mupenTransferPak.description: Enables Transfer Pak configuration UI for Mupen64Plus N64 cores. Allows mounting a GB/GBC ROM into a virtual Transfer Pak for games like Pokémon Stadium. Disabled by default — enable in Settings > Advanced > Feature Flags.

netplayEnabled.description: Enables native SwiftUI netplay UI for RetroArch cores (LAN room browser, host/join, in-game HUD). RetroArch already has HAVE_NETPLAY compiled in — this gates the native Provenance UI on top. Disabled by default during Phase 1-3 development.
